alert.rallyguard.scroll_of_rallying.stre: You started a Rally! Your guards within 100 blocks were teleported to you.
You ended the Rally. Your rallied guards hold their ground where they stand.
gui.rallyguard.hire.title: Hire Guard
gui.rallyguard.hire.body:
Hire guards to join your army.
(cost: 3 emeralds).
gui.rallyguard.hire.already_owned: This guard is already part of your army.
item.rallyguard.commanders_ledger.toolti: Open the panel to command your guards.
gui.rallyguard.command.title: Command Panel
gui.rallyguard.command.empty: You haven't hired any guards yet.
gui.rallyguard.command.name: Guard
gui.rallyguard.command.not_owner: You are not this guard’s commander.
gui.rallyguard.command.summoned: Guard summoned - holding position in front of you.
gui.rallyguard.command.squad_none_select: Select at least one guard first.
gui.rallyguard.command.attack_no_target: No valid target found for that order.
item.rallyguard.commanders_ledger.toolti: Sneak + right-click: mark a target or a formation point (air: clear marks).
gui.rallyguard.command.target_cleared: %s guard(s) no longer have a designated target.
gui.rallyguard.command.select_hint: Click guards (or a chip above) to select them
gui.rallyguard.command.kamikaze_issued: %s guard(s) charging %s. There is no way back.
gui.rallyguard.command.kamikaze_unarmed: No selected guard carries TNT in its off hand (give it one in its inventory).
gui.rallyguard.tip.summon: Teleport this guard in front of you; it waits there until your next order.
gui.rallyguard.tip.post: Post this guard where YOU stand: it guards that spot and returns to it after every fight.
gui.rallyguard.tip.unpost: Release this guard from its post: it roams freely again.
gui.rallyguard.tip.select_all: Select every guard loaded around you (far-away villages are not included).
gui.rallyguard.tip.select_squad: Select every loaded guard of this squad.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_name: Squad for the selected guards. Use Squad/Unit (e.g. Village1/Archers) for a sub-group. Also the new name for Rename and ✎.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_pick: Cycle through your existing squads (also selects that squad).
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_assign: Put the selected guards in the squad named on the left.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_clear: Take the selected guards out of their squad.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_passive: Passive: never fights, not even when hit. Explicit orders still apply.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_defensive: Defensive (default): only fights back against whoever hits it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_aggressive: Aggressive: attacks nearby monsters and enemy guards on its own.
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_ruthless: Ruthless: attacks any nearby creature (never players, your guards or pets).
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_recall: To me: teleport in formation in front of you and WAIT there until your next order.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_hold: Hold ground: stop and hold the spot where each guard stands now.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_reform: Back to the last formation they mustered in.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_break_ranks: Leave post/formation and act freely by stance (Reform brings them back).
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_kamikaze: Guards carrying TNT in the off hand run at the chosen target and blow up (never with friends within 6 blocks). They always die; your side takes reduced blast damage.
gui.rallyguard.tip.target_select: Who to fight: click to cycle. Sneak + right-click something with the Ledger to mark it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_attack: Designate the chosen target. Under hold fire they mark it but don't shoot until released. Posted guards only fight it near their post.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_hold_fire: Weapons down: they won't fight at all, not even back, until released.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_release_fire: Weapons free: engage the designated target now if it's in reach.
gui.rallyguard.tip.muster: Form up in this shape on the marked formation point (or on you) and hold it.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_retreat: Break off and fall back: to the marked point if there is one; otherwise to their squad's HQ (banner); otherwise they follow you.
gui.rallyguard.command.kamikaze_waiting: %s is holding its charge: friends are too close to the target.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_follow: Follow me: they walk (or ride) after you wherever you go. Leaves any post.
gui.rallyguard.tip.order_advance: The whole formation advances 16 blocks - or to the marked point, facing it - each guard keeping its slot.
gui.rallyguard.tip.tab_guards: Guards in no squad, one by one (squad members are under Squads; open a squad to see its guards here).
gui.rallyguard.tip.tab_squads: Your squads as groups: select, rename or disband a whole squad.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_rename: Rename this squad/unit to the name typed in the squad field below.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_disband: Disband this squad (two clicks). Its guards stay yours. Disbanding a unit keeps its guards in the squad.
gui.rallyguard.command.no_squads: No squads yet: select guards and type a name in the squad field below.
gui.rallyguard.command.squad_name_taken: You already have a squad called "%s".
key.rallyguard.fire: Hold fire / Fire at will (sneak: Retreat)
gui.rallyguard.key.selected_one: Selected: %s. The next command goes to this guard only.
gui.rallyguard.key.nobody: No guards in command - select some (sneak + Command on a guard, or the Ledger), or have them follow you.
gui.rallyguard.key.moved: %s guard(s) moving there - they'll hold it.
gui.rallyguard.key.nothing_to_manage: Nothing to do with that - point at one of your guards, a mount or a block.
gui.rallyguard.key.marked: Point marked at %s (Muster / Retreat form up here; the same spot again lifts it).
gui.rallyguard.key.cleared: Selection cleared - commands go to the guards following you.
gui.rallyguard.key.mount_taken: That mount already has a rider.
gui.rallyguard.key.mount_untamed: Tame that horse first (and it must be yours).
gui.rallyguard.key.no_rider: No guard in command without a mount within %s blocks.
gui.rallyguard.command.forget_alive: That guard is right here and alive - it can't be forgotten.
gui.rallyguard.command.rename_far: That guard isn't loaded - get closer to rename it.
gui.rallyguard.command.guard_lost: %s was lost (turned into a zombie villager or removed from the world).
gui.rallyguard.command.loss_army: ↳ %s fell · %s guard(s) left in your army.
gui.rallyguard.tip.forget: Remove this missing guard from the Ledger (two clicks). Use it for guards that are gone for good.
gui.rallyguard.tip.rename_guard: Rename the ONE selected guard to the text in the field.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_view: Show only this squad/unit's guards, one by one (and select them).
gui.rallyguard.command.attack_held: %s guard(s) are under HOLD FIRE: %s is marked as their target; they open fire when you release them (H).
gui.rallyguard.tip.unit_name: You're inside a squad: the name you type is a UNIT of it. Assign puts the selected guards in that unit; Clear takes them out of their unit (they stay in the squad).
gui.rallyguard.tip.select_unit: Select every loaded guard of this unit.
gui.rallyguard.command.squad_assigned_jo: %s guard(s) in %s · %s took their place in its formation.
gui.rallyguard.command.retreat_point: %s guard(s) fall back to the marked point.
gui.rallyguard.command.retreat_hq: %s guard(s) fall back to their squad's HQ.
gui.rallyguard.command.retreat_follow: No retreat point or HQ: %s guard(s) break off and follow you.
gui.rallyguard.command.retreat_mixed: %s to their HQ, %s follow you (their squad has no HQ).
gui.rallyguard.command.hq_lost: The HQ banner of %s is gone: HQ lost. Claim another with sneak + Command on a banner.
gui.rallyguard.key.unmarked: Temporary point lifted: retreats now go to each squad's HQ (or to you).
gui.rallyguard.key.hq_no_squad: The guards in command have no squad - give them one before giving them an HQ.
gui.rallyguard.command.commander_fell: You fell: %s guard(s) that followed you hold the place where you fell.
gui.rallyguard.command.commander_fell_av: You fell: %s guard(s) hold the place and go after %s.
gui.rallyguard.tip.fire_mode: How the selected archers and gunners move while shooting. Click for the next mode: Normal (close to their best range) → Still (never move) → Advance (shoot while advancing) → Fall back (keep their distance) → Volley (arc arrows over walls and at far targets).
gui.rallyguard.tip.tab_hq: Your headquarters: create, rename, delete, pick one, and give it to squads.
gui.rallyguard.hq.created: HQ "%s" created where you stand (and picked).
gui.rallyguard.hq.deleted: HQ "%s" deleted; its squads have no HQ now.
gui.rallyguard.hq.none: No HQs yet - "+ HQ here", or sneak + Command on a banner with a squad in command.
gui.rallyguard.tip.hq_create: Create a new HQ at your position, named with the text in the field below (or numbered).
gui.rallyguard.tip.hq_select: Pick this HQ: a banner you sneak + Command becomes its position. Click again to unpick.
gui.rallyguard.tip.hq_assign: Give this HQ to the squad named in the field below (squads can share an HQ).
gui.rallyguard.tip.hq_rename: Rename this HQ to the text in the field below.
gui.rallyguard.tip.hq_delete: Delete this HQ (two clicks). Squads using it are left without one.
gui.rallyguard.tip.pack: War pack: 6 slots of ammo, food, potions, dynamite or a second weapon (the guard must be within 16 blocks).
gui.rallyguard.command.pack_far: Get within %s blocks of that guard to open its pack.
gui.rallyguard.pack.title: %s - war pack
gui.rallyguard.key.hq_linked: HQ "%s" moved to the banner at %s.
gui.rallyguard.debug.ranked: Test rank %2$s set on %1$s guard(s) (no effect on behavior until E2).
gui.rallyguard.sim.run: Sim %s (seed %s): %s wins - blue %s/%s, red %s/%s alive, %s s. %s run(s) left.
gui.rallyguard.sim.bad_scenario: No known scenario: use A, B, C, D, ALL or an id from config/rallyguard-sim-scenarios.json.
gui.rallyguard.sim.busy: A simulation is already running (/rally sim stop ends it).
gui.rallyguard.tip.batch: Previous / next batch of guards (the army is bigger than one batch).
gui.rallyguard.detail.captain: ★ Captain of its unit (most command capacity)
gui.rallyguard.command.unit_routed: The unit lost too many captains and routs: %s break ranks, %s of them flee.
gui.rallyguard.vet.reckless: %s has cheated death too often and fights recklessly!
gui.rallyguard.sim.batch_started: Simulation batch '%s': %s run(s). Ground arena at %s %s %s (chunks kept loaded), speed %s. /rally sim stop ends it.
gui.rallyguard.sim.batch_done: Simulation finished: %s run(s). Results: %s (summary.md, summary.json, runs.jsonl)
gui.rallyguard.sim.no_site: No free, dry, flat site without buildings found for the arena (simulation.arenaDistance). Nothing was changed.
gui.rallyguard.sim.bad_option: Unknown or invalid option near: %s (use --minutes N, --seeds N, --tickrate sprint|normal)
gui.rallyguard.tip.stance_cycle: Stance of the first selected guard. Click: the whole selection gets the next one (Passive, Defensive, Aggressive, Ruthless).
gui.rallyguard.tip.doctrine_cycle: Doctrine: how the selection weighs retreat, distance and terrain (decision ladder). Click: next doctrine. Not saved across restarts yet.
gui.rallyguard.tip.squad_attack: Attack with this whole squad (its online members) at the target chosen in the Attack bar.
gui.rallyguard.command.degraded: %s %s: %s instead (that order doesn't apply to them).
gui.rallyguard.command.attack_group_issu: %s guard(s) spread over a group of %s around %s.
